title: Chile Relleno
description: Chile Relleno is a dish from Mexico prepared with poblano pepper, oaxaca cheese, egg white, egg yolk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cut the vegetables evenly and roast at 200°C for about 18 minutes until tender and lightly charred.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Hollow or prepare the vegetables, then fill with the prepared mixture without packing too tightly.
Whisk or whip the listed ingredients to a smooth, light consistency, then keep cool until needed.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 18 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 10 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
